# Techneyo Solutions — Global Digital Product Agency

> Techneyo Solutions is an international software development and digital growth agency. We build custom web applications, enterprise CRM systems, mobile apps (iOS & Android), and high-converting WhatsApp lead automation workflows for businesses across the United States, Europe, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, UAE, and Asia.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Custom Web Application & Website Development
- Modern high-converting business websites, SaaS MVPs, and customer portals.
- Tech Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase.
- Deliverables: 100% responsive, SEO-optimized, sub-second load times, and custom CMS/admin panels.

### 2. Custom CRM Systems & Admin Dashboards
- Tailored internal business tools, operational workflows, customer relationship management (CRM), and reporting dashboards.
- Integrations: WhatsApp Business API, Stripe, payment gateways, Google Sheets, email triggers, and webhook pipelines.

### 3. WhatsApp Business Automation & AI Agents
- Automated lead qualification chatbots, 24/7 customer enquiry routing, broadcast campaigns, appointment booking bots, and seamless CRM synchronization.
- Official WhatsApp Business Cloud API integration.

### 4. Mobile Application Development
- Cross-platform native mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native and Flutter.
- Offline support, push notifications, native device integrations, and App Store / Google Play publishing.

### 5. Paid Acquisition & Digital Growth
- Google Ads (Search & Local Map Pack) and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) engineered for direct B2B and B2C inbound lead generation.
